AP=I(unrounded A0*AP_percent/100). A0 includes legacy raw-role/L/C/D/elite/1.35/unit10 but no specialization. Caster active primary damage: I((0.25*A0_budget_share + coefficient*AP)*tier_skill*difficulty_skill); cast base budget shared once across main packets, excluded from status ticks, followups, support and environment. Crit only eligible direct attack-source damage; frozen RNG and per-cast correlation pending implementation.
coefficient_authority: Tank and base1.0 user-exact. Other per-ID coefficients are assistant proposals pending bounded combat, not user-specified.
